method: R1 blind suread (subagent read text only, no md/rules)

facts.fact: 哈蒂穿上跑鞋离开小屋，冒着稀疏的雨沿车道慢跑。
facts.anchor: Hattie dons her running gear and leaves the cottage, jogging down the driveway through half-hearted rain.

facts.fact: 她这才知道达斯汀惹的麻烦不是单一事件，而是一连串，最终因在简·埃弗森家被害者的床上睡觉被抓。
facts.anchor: But she hadn’t known the extent of it. Hadn’t known it wasn’t a single incident but a spate of them culminating in being caught sleeping in—

facts.fact: 她想，要是达斯汀的父母能像掩盖他的过错那样花力气帮助儿子就好了。
facts.anchor: If only Dustin’s parents had invested as much energy into helping their son as they did in covering up his offenses.

facts.fact: 看到斯隆的信箱时，她意识到汤米肯定知道达斯汀惹的麻烦却一字未提。
facts.anchor: The other fact that settles upon her as Sloan’s mailbox comes into view is that Tommy probably knew, no, definitely knew, about the trouble Dustin had gotten into and never said a word.

facts.fact: 她设想艾丽西亚的死是否在达斯汀心里造成了化脓而非愈合的伤口。
facts.anchor: What if Alicia’s death had created a wound inside him that had festered instead of healed?

facts.fact: 尽管肺部和腿部肌肉灼痛，她反倒加快步伐，想把这些新疑团甩开。
facts.anchor: Her lungs begin to burn along with the muscles in her legs, but she continues on, actually pushing a little harder as if to keep these new suspicions at arm’s length.

facts.fact: 雨下大时她转身开始往家跑。
facts.anchor: When the rain begins falling harder she turns around and starts back home.

facts.fact: 她停在车道尽头，看见一辆警长的巡逻车停在房前。
facts.anchor: A sheriff’s cruiser is parked before her house.
